zpl.ponder.assembly.text_1: To assemble a ship, first build a Launch Platform.
zpl.ponder.assembly.text_2: Next, build your ship on top.
zpl.ponder.assembly.text_3: Then, place a Launch Button on the platform, and press it to assemble your ship.
zpl.ponder.thruster.text_1: Ion Thrusters can be used to propel a ship.
zpl.ponder.thruster.text_2: To set one up, place an Ion Thrust Modulator in front of an Ion Thruster Exhaust.
zpl.ponder.thruster.text_3: Activate the thruster by providing FE and a Redstone Signal to the Ion Thrust Modulator block.
